name: Google Meet
description: Optimized for Google Meet - uses WS_EX_APPWINDOW to appear as a regular application window
explanation: Google Meet (running in Chrome/Edge) detects windows using the standard Windows Desktop Duplication API and prefers windows with WS_EX_APPWINDOW extended style. This profile ensures the window appears as a regular application with layered rendering for smooth video output. The window is sent to HWND_BOTTOM z-order while remaining fully opaque and visible.
